 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 Rick C 
 
 
 
 Verified 
Unforgettable experience with Summit Experts
Absolutely best company in Pakistan! We had a 6 day action packed adventure around North Pakistan with Summit Experts, and we are so happy we chose them. After emailing and what’s app messaging for months, changing our itinerary many times, they were so patient, and accomodating with our custom tour requests, their communication skills are perfect. Our guide Ibadat, and driver Abbas met us at the airport in Skardu on time, and we instantly knew that they were going to be legends, they’re such humble, chilled, happy, and funny guys. Ibadat is a true mountain warrior, these mountains are his passion in life, so he was the perfect hiking partner to show us his beautiful country. Their English is really good too, so that made it easy for us the whole time. We had an absolute blast, and such good memories with these two. We will never forget their cool playlists in the car on our drives everyday. Anyone thinking about using Summit Experts for your North Pakistan adventure, I cannot recommend enough, you’ll be in good hands and take away the best memories. Thanks Summit Crew
  
 
  
 
 
 
 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 natmarie 
 
 
 
 Verified 
Exception company and trip
From start to finish Summit Experts allowed us to design our North Pakistan itinerary to allow us to see as much as we could in our 6 days. The itinerary was the perfect balance of some adventure, lots of activities and cultural exploration, allowing us to experience the destination in a way that felt authentic and exciting. Every detail was perfectly organized, from top communication from the company, transportation and stunning accommodations to the activities and local experiences. Our guide Ibadat was fantastic, a mountain warrior. He was so patient especially with my coffee results haha. He kept us safe and made our trip so wonderful explaining local culture to us. His passion is the mountains and hikes so he is your man for any adventures. Our driver, the legend Abbas was an exceptional driver. Totally professional and he drove so careful and safe. He was also just the nicest guy and we all had many laughs together along our journey. I cannot thank him enough. He was the best driver in Pakistan. I would massively recommend using Summit Experts for any type of trip. For summits, hikes or just exploring the areas. They cover it all and the nicest kindest people. Thank you to everyone who made this trip extremely special and memorable for us. We can’t wait to show how beautiful Pakistan is to all our friends and family. Dil Pakistan. Until we meet again.

North Pakistan is a BLESSING
What an amazing team to travel. These guys are very professional and locals who knows every corner of the North pakistan. We loved our itinerary which was perfectly mixed up with day hikes and cultural sightseeing exposure. Love your Australia :)
  
 
  
 
 
 
 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 Kateřina Z

Great mixture of sighseeing and nature hikes around north Pakistan 😍
100% recommend! We did a 6 day trip around Hunza valley and Skardu and the whole experience was amazing! Azhar was a great guide, chill guy and just fun to be around with. The whole trip was a great mixture of hiking, sightseeing and great food experiences. The schedule was also super flexible and they were able to adapt it according to our desires, weather and comfort. Nanga Parbat
Thank you Shah and the team for making my visit to Pakistan very memorable. We took a very non-traditional way, with very few people on the way, and yet everything went as smoothly as it could. Despite traveling solo as a female, I felt safe with him. Thank you!
  
 
  
 
 
 
 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 Olena B 
 
 
 
 Verified 
A Journey to Remember
I just returned from an incredible month-long adventure in northern Pakistan with Summit Experts Adventure Tours. We trekked through some of the most breathtaking regions: Skardu, Hunza, Shimshal Village, and made our way to Shimshal Pass, ending with the exhilarating summit of Manglik Sar (6050m). From the very first moment, I knew I was in the hands of true professionals. The entire trip was perfectly organized, from the logistics to safety measures. But what truly made this experience stand out was the team. Every single person was warm, supportive, and treated me like family. Over the course of the trek, they all became a second family to me, and I genuinely feel like I’ve made lifelong friends. The beauty of the Karakoram combined with the knowledge, passion, and dedication of the Summit Experts team made this adventure unforgettable. I felt supported, safe, and inspired every single day. I don’t add pictures, because you MUST visit and see all the beauty of Pakistan with your own eyes. Nothing can compare to standing there in person, taking in the vastness and the majesty of the Karakoram range. Thanks to the expertise of Summit Experts, I felt safe and supported every step of the way. The team’s passion for the mountains and commitment to making sure each trekker has the best possible experience is what really sets them apart. This wasn’t just a trek—it was an unforgettable journey, and I already can’t wait to return. I’m already thinking about next year and planning to do even more trekking in Pakistan. There’s so much more to explore, and I wouldn’t want to do it with anyone else but Summit Experts. If you’re considering an adventure in Pakistan, I cannot recommend this company enough. Thank you, Summit Experts, for an experience I’ll never forget.
  
 
  
 
 
 
 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 Wasin S 
 
 
 
 Verified 
Trip ปากีสถาน Blossom 2025
It was one of the best trips in my life, whether it was the beautiful nature or the team that took good care of me from the first day I arrived until the day I returned, throughout the 11 days. If you are looking for an experienced team to guide you around, who will provide you with newness and a good impression, I would like you to try our services, and I believe you will not be disappointed.
  
 
  
 
 
 
 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 Chongdee C 
 
 
 
 Verified 
Beyond the ordinary
It took me some time to find the right words to capture the incredible memories we created during our trip to northern Pakistan this April—blossom season at its absolute best! The breathtaking views, the warmth of the people, and the richness of the culture left a lasting impression on me, all made even more special by the Summit Experts Adventure Tours team. Their approach was not just professional but also incredibly humble and flexible, ensuring we had an unforgettable experience. Our group of five Thai friends explored Skardu, Hunza, Passu, and Gilgit at the peak of blossom season. Guided by the company’s CEO, Shah, whose extensive expertise in hiking and expeditions was evident, we found ourselves on a well-planned yet refreshingly adaptable journey. We appreciated how our tour leader went above and beyond, recommending exclusive experiences—from an insightful cultural visit to a local Pakistani home to a glacier trek using a unique route. Unlike standard itineraries, this allowed us to truly get up close and touch the glacier, all while ensuring our safety with expert guidance. One of the highlights was our trek to Fairy Meadows. With hours of hiking ahead, our guide was highly attentive, carefully assessing the natural conditions and our group’s well-being, which made us feel completely safe every step of the way. I already can't wait to return to Pakistan in summer, autumn, and beyond! 😊 A little tip for fellow travelers: If you plan to visit areas that require trekking and hiking, I highly recommend familiarizing yourself with the terrain beforehand. You can always check with the Summit Experts Adventure Tours team about the travel conditions—just to be prepared, not to opt out! The beauty of northern Pakistan is absolutely worth the effort.
  
 
  
 
 
 
 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 Fuzzy 
 
 
 
 Verified 
Amazing First Trip to Pakistan with Summit Experts Tours 🫶🏽
I had an amazing time travelling to Pakistan with the Summit Experts Tour! Everything was super well organized, and the guides were awesome — really friendly and knew so much about the places we visited. The whole trip was a great mix of adventure, sightseeing, and just soaking in the local culture. I felt safe and taken care of the whole way. Definitely recommend them if you're thinking about exploring Pakistan.
  
 
  
 
 
 
 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 Chang J 
 
 
 
 Verified 
The great team, the great place and the great Hunza people.
Thanks to Shah Doulat the CEO of the Summit Experts Adventure Tours and his team arranged a great wonderful trip for us. Looking forward to going back again.....

 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 Olena B 
 
 
 
 Verified 
A Journey to Remember
I just returned from an incredible month-long adventure in northern Pakistan with Summit Experts Adventure Tours. We trekked through some of the most breathtaking regions: Skardu, Hunza, Shimshal Village, and made our way to Shimshal Pass, ending with the exhilarating summit of Manglik Sar (6050m). From the very first moment, I knew I was in the hands of true professionals. The entire trip was perfectly organized, from the logistics to safety measures. But what truly made this experience stand out was the team. Every single person was warm, supportive, and treated me like family. Over the course of the trek, they all became a second family to me, and I genuinely feel like I’ve made lifelong friends. The beauty of the Karakoram combined with the knowledge, passion, and dedication of the Summit Experts team made this adventure unforgettable. I felt supported, safe, and inspired every single day. I don’t add pictures, because you MUST visit and see all the beauty of Pakistan with your own eyes. Nothing can compare to standing there in person, taking in the vastness and the majesty of the Karakoram range. Thanks to the expertise of Summit Experts, I felt safe and supported every step of the way. The team’s passion for the mountains and commitment to making sure each trekker has the best possible experience is what really sets them apart. This wasn’t just a trek—it was an unforgettable journey, and I already can’t wait to return. I’m already thinking about next year and planning to do even more trekking in Pakistan. There’s so much more to explore, and I wouldn’t want to do it with anyone else but Summit Experts. If you’re considering an adventure in Pakistan, I cannot recommend this company enough. Thank you, Summit Experts, for an experience I’ll never forget.
  
 
  
 
 
 
 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 Wasin S 
 
 
 
 Verified 
Trip ปากีสถาน Blossom 2025
It was one of the best trips in my life, whether it was the beautiful nature or the team that took good care of me from the first day I arrived until the day I returned, throughout the 11 days. If you are looking for an experienced team to guide you around, who will provide you with newness and a good impression, I would like you to try our services, and I believe you will not be disappointed.
  
 
  
 
 
 
 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 Chongdee C 
 
 
 
 Verified 
Beyond the ordinary
It took me some time to find the right words to capture the incredible memories we created during our trip to northern Pakistan this April—blossom season at its absolute best! The breathtaking views, the warmth of the people, and the richness of the culture left a lasting impression on me, all made even more special by the Summit Experts Adventure Tours team. Their approach was not just professional but also incredibly humble and flexible, ensuring we had an unforgettable experience. Our group of five Thai friends explored Skardu, Hunza, Passu, and Gilgit at the peak of blossom season. Guided by the company’s CEO, Shah, whose extensive expertise in hiking and expeditions was evident, we found ourselves on a well-planned yet refreshingly adaptable journey. We appreciated how our tour leader went above and beyond, recommending exclusive experiences—from an insightful cultural visit to a local Pakistani home to a glacier trek using a unique route. Unlike standard itineraries, this allowed us to truly get up close and touch the glacier, all while ensuring our safety with expert guidance. One of the highlights was our trek to Fairy Meadows. With hours of hiking ahead, our guide was highly attentive, carefully assessing the natural conditions and our group’s well-being, which made us feel completely safe every step of the way. I already can't wait to return to Pakistan in summer, autumn, and beyond! 😊 A little tip for fellow travelers: If you plan to visit areas that require trekking and hiking, I highly recommend familiarizing yourself with the terrain beforehand. You can always check with the Summit Experts Adventure Tours team about the travel conditions—just to be prepared, not to opt out! The beauty of northern Pakistan is absolutely worth the effort.
  
 
  
 
 
 
 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 Fuzzy

Amazing First Trip to Pakistan with Summit Experts Tours 🫶🏽
I had an amazing time travelling to Pakistan with the Summit Experts Tour! Everything was super well organized, and the guides were awesome — really friendly and knew so much about the places we visited. The whole trip was a great mix of adventure, sightseeing, and just soaking in the local culture. I felt safe and taken care of the whole way. Definitely recommend them if you're thinking about exploring Pakistan.

Overview

About Expedition

The Hunza Valley 9-Day Tour is a mesmerizing journey through Pakistan’s most picturesque landscapes. From the ancient forts of Hunza to the breathtaking views of Khunjerab Pass, this trip is designed for travelers seeking a perfect blend of adventure, history, and cultural exploration. The expedition covers Islamabad, Gilgit, Hunza, Attabad Lake, Gojal Valley, and Naltar Valley, offering a well-rounded experience of northern Pakistan.

Why This Tour?

  • Unparalleled Beauty: Experience the stunning landscapes of Rakaposhi Viewpoint, Passu Cones, and Khunjerab National Park.
  • Rich Heritage: Visit ancient Baltit Fort, Altit Fort, and the Royal Garden for a deep dive into Hunza’s history.
  • Cultural Immersion: Engage with local communities, enjoy traditional Hunza cuisine, and explore vibrant bazaars.
  • Adventure & Serenity: Enjoy serene lakes, scenic hikes, and breathtaking mountain views all in one trip.

Packing List

Spring Packing Checklist for Northern Pakistan - Summit Experts

Spring (late-March to May) is one of the best seasons to explore Northern Pakistan, with mild weather, blooming flowers, and lush green landscapes. To make sure you have a comfortable and enjoyable journey, we’ve prepared a comprehensive packing list for your adventure.

Essential Packing Categories:

  • Luggage & Bags
  • Main Luggage (70-80L): A sturdy, spacious bag for all your essentials. Ensure it has waterproof covers for unexpected weather.
  • Daypack (30-40L): Ideal for carrying daily items like snacks, water, and your camera during excursions.
  • Padlocks: Secure your belongings during travel.
  • Clothing
  • Upper Body:
      • Lightweight Jacket: Perfect for chilly mornings and evenings. Consider a windbreaker or fleece.
      • Long-Sleeve Shirts & T-Shirts: Comfortable, breathable fabrics are ideal for layering.
      • Rain Jacket: Waterproof and wind-resistant for unexpected spring showers.
  • Lower Body:
      • Trekking Trousers: Lightweight and quick-drying trousers for hikes and outdoor activities.
      • Comfortable Pants/Jeans: Suitable for both city tours and countryside visits.
  • General Tips:
    • Layer Up: The weather can vary, so layers will help you adjust to temperature changes.
    • Respect Local Culture: Modest clothing is recommended, especially in towns and cultural sites.
  • Footwear
  • Hiking Boots: Well-worn, waterproof boots with good ankle support for trekking.
  • Comfortable Walking Shoes: For city exploration and casual outings.
  • Warm Socks: Preferably made of moisture-wicking material.
  • Accessories
  • Sunblock (SPF 50+): Protects against strong UV rays.
  • Hat/Cap: For sun protection during hikes and outdoor tours.
  • Sunglasses: Good UV protection for your eyes.
  • Light Scarf/Bandana: Useful for dust protection and sun cover.
  • Toiletries & Personal Care
  • Compact Toiletry Kit: Include essentials like toothpaste, deodorant, and moisturizer.
  • Travel Towel: Quick-drying and lightweight.
  • Wet Wipes & Hand Sanitizer: For maintaining hygiene during day trips.
  • Hydration & Snacks
  • Reusable Water Bottle (Insulated Preferred): Stay hydrated, especially during hikes.
  • Energy Bars & Snacks: Lightweight snacks for quick energy boosts.
  • Tech & Gadgets
  • Camera & Accessories: Capture stunning landscapes and cultural moments. Bring extra memory cards.
  • Power Bank: Essential for keeping devices charged on the go.
  • Travel Adapter: Ensure compatibility with local sockets.
  • Important Documents
  • Passport: Must have at least six months of validity remaining.
  • Visa & Travel Insurance: Check visa requirements and carry printouts of your insurance details.

Emergency Contact Information: A printed list of important contacts

Tips for Spring Travel

  • Prepare for Variable Weather: Spring can bring unexpected showers, so a waterproof jacket and protective covers for your belongings are recommended.
  • Comfortable Layers: Temperatures fluctuate, so plan for both warm afternoons and cool evenings.
  • Be Ready for Long Walks: Comfortable shoes and a light backpack will make your excursions more enjoyable.

Why Travel with Summit Experts?

Our experienced team ensures that your journey is not just comfortable, but also safe and unforgettable. We provide personalized packing recommendations based on your specific tour itinerary, and our guides are always ready to help you with any last-minute needs.

Overview

About Expedition

The Fairy Meadows Tour offers an unforgettable adventure through the heart of Pakistan’s northern landscapes. This journey takes you from Islamabad to the breathtaking Fairy Meadows, offering unparalleled views of Nanga Parbat, the ninth-highest mountain in the world. Experience thrilling jeep rides, scenic hikes, and cultural immersion while exploring the majestic Karakoram region.

Why This Tour?

✔️ Spectacular Landscapes: Witness the beauty of Nanga Parbat, Raikot Glacier, and lush alpine meadows.
✔️ Thrilling Adventure: Enjoy an exhilarating off-road jeep ride and trek through pristine trails.
✔️ Cultural Experience: Meet local communities, learn their traditions, and savor local cuisine.
✔️ Wildlife & Nature: Discover a variety of flora and fauna along the journey.

Itinerary

Day 1: Arrival in Islamabad

Upon arrival at Islamabad International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by our team and transferred to your hotel. After checking in, take the opportunity to rest and refresh yourself from your journey. In the evening, enjoy a welcome dinner where you will meet fellow travelers and get a briefing on the upcoming adventure. If time allows, explore Islamabad’s vibrant shopping districts or take a leisurely stroll through the city.

Options:

  • Premium: Islamabad Serena Hotel
  • Luxury: Roomy Signature Hotel
  • Standard: Grand Islamabad Hotel

Day 2: Drive to Chilas

The journey to Chilas begins early in the morning as we embark on a scenic drive along the legendary Karakoram Highway. This breathtaking route, often referred to as the “Eighth Wonder of the World,” offers mesmerizing views of the Hazara Region and the mighty Indus River. A stop will be made for lunch at a local roadside restaurant, allowing you to savor regional flavors before continuing toward Chilas. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and unwind, preparing for the adventure ahead.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Shangrila Hotel Chilas
  • Luxury: Shangrila Hotel Chilas
  • Standard: Indus Lodges

Day 3: Drive to Raikot Bridge – Jeep to Tattu Village – Trek to Fairy Meadows

After breakfast, we will drive to Raikot Bridge, the gateway to Fairy Meadows. From here, an exhilarating 1.5-hour off-road jeep ride will take you to Tattu Village, a small settlement nestled in the mountains. The adventure continues with a picturesque 2-3 hour trek through lush pine forests, leading to the legendary Fairy Meadows. Upon arrival, settle into your cozy cottage or campsite, then take in the panoramic views of Nanga Parbat. Spend the evening exploring or simply relaxing in the serene surroundings.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Raikot Sarai
  • Luxury: Raikot Sarai
  • Standard: Fairy Meadows Cottages

Day 4: Trek to Beyal Camp & Nanga Parbat Base Camp (Optional)

For those seeking an extra dose of adventure, today offers an optional trek to Beyal Camp and Nanga Parbat Base Camp. The trail to Beyal Camp takes approximately 2-3 hours and offers spectacular views of the Raikot Glacier and surrounding peaks. If you’re up for the challenge, continue for another 2 hours to reach Nanga Parbat Base Camp, standing at the foot of one of the world’s highest mountains. Enjoy a picnic-style lunch with unparalleled views before retracing your steps back to Fairy Meadows, where a well-earned evening of relaxation awaits.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Raikot Sarai
  • Luxury: Raikot Sarai
  • Standard: Fairy Meadows Cottages

Day 5: Free Day at Fairy Meadows

Take a well-deserved break and soak in the beauty of Fairy Meadows at your own pace. This leisure day allows you to explore nearby viewpoints, take stunning photographs, or simply relax in the alpine meadows. Interact with local communities, enjoy traditional food, and immerse yourself in the peaceful ambiance of this remote paradise.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Raikot Sarai
  • Luxury: Raikot Sarai
  • Standard: Fairy Meadows Cottages

Day 6: Trek Back to Tattu Village – Jeep Ride – Drive to Besham/Naran

After breakfast, bid farewell to Fairy Meadows as we begin the trek back to Tattu Village. Upon reaching the village, hop onto a jeep for a rugged ride back to Raikot Bridge, where we will continue our journey by road toward Besham or Naran Valley. The drive is filled with stunning landscapes and scenic stops for lunch and refreshments. Upon arrival, check into your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Hilton Hotel Besham / Sarai Hotel Naran
  • Luxury: Hilton Hotel Besham / Mount Feast Hotel Naran
  • Standard: Besham Inn / Mount Feast Hotel Naran

Day 7: Return to Islamabad & City Tour

Leaving the mountains behind, we begin our return journey to Islamabad. The 7-8 hour drive will take us back through scenic landscapes, offering the perfect opportunity to reflect on the incredible adventure. Upon reaching Islamabad, we will embark on a city tour, visiting iconic landmarks such as Faisal Mosque, Pakistan Monument, and the Parliament House. The evening is free for last-minute shopping or exploring Islamabad’s culinary delights before heading back to the hotel.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Islamabad Serena Hotel
  • Luxury: Roomy Signature Hotel
  • Standard: Grand Islamabad Hotel

Day 8: Departure from Islamabad

After breakfast, you will be transferred to Islamabad International Airport for your return flight home. As you say goodbye to Pakistan’s northern wonders, take with you unforgettable memories of Fairy Meadows, Nanga Parbat, and the extraordinary landscapes of the Karakoram region.

Packing List

Year-Round Essentials

✔️ Comfortable trekking shoes (durable and waterproof for rocky and forest trails)
✔️ Lightweight daypack (for carrying essentials during treks)
✔️ Camera or smartphone (to capture the stunning landscapes)
✔️ Water bottle (hydration is key during treks)
✔️ Personal ID & travel documents (Passport, CNIC, or any required permits)
✔️ Sunglasses & sunscreen (for sun protection, especially at higher altitudes)
✔️ Hand sanitizer & face mask (optional, for hygiene)
✔️ Snacks (energy bars, trail mix, etc. for hiking)

Seasonal Clothing

🌸 Spring (March – April) & 🍂 Autumn (October – November)
✔️ Light jacket or sweater (for cool mornings and evenings)
✔️ Long-sleeve shirts & pants (to protect from sun and insects)
✔️ Comfortable, breathable clothing
✔️ Warm hat or beanie (for evenings)

☀️ Summer (May – September)
✔️ Light, breathable clothing (cotton or moisture-wicking material)
✔️ Hat or cap for sun protection
✔️ Light jacket (for cooler mountain evenings)
✔️ Hiking pants (quick-drying fabric preferred)

❄️ Winter (December – February)
✔️ Warm insulated jacket (preferably waterproof)
✔️ Gloves, scarf, and beanie (to protect from the cold)
✔️ Thermal layers (for warmth under clothing)
✔️ Fleece or woolen socks (to keep feet warm)

Additional Gear for Trekking

✔️ Sleeping bag (for camping at Fairy Meadows or in mountain areas)
✔️ Headlamp or flashlight (with extra batteries)
✔️ Trekking poles (optional, but helpful for balance during hikes)
✔️ Waterproof jacket and pants (in case of rain)
✔️ Small first aid kit (band-aids, blister pads, pain relievers, etc.)
✔️ Personal hygiene items (toothbrush, toothpaste, wet wipes, etc.)

Optional Items

✔️ Camera gear (for professional photographers, bring extra lenses and memory cards)
✔️ Binoculars (for birdwatching or spotting wildlife)
✔️ Power bank (to keep your devices charged)

Key Information

  • Destinations Covered: Faisal Mosque, Pakistan Monument, Lok Virsa Museum, Daman-e-Koh, Margalla Hills Trail 3 or 5 (optional hike).
  • Tour Duration: Full-day tour (6-8 hours).
  • Best Season: Year-round (Spring & Autumn offer the best weather).
  • Difficulty Level: Easy – Suitable for all ages, with minimal walking (hike is optional).
  • Starting & Ending Point: Islamabad (Hotel pickup & drop-off included).
  • Entry Requirements: No special permits required; foreign travelers should carry identification.
  • Meals: Lunch
  • Transport: Private vehicle with driver and English-speaking guide.
  • Additional Costs: Entry fees (if applicable), personal expenses, and optional hiking gear.
  • Customizations: Available upon request (special pickup from another city may incur additional charges).

FAQs

01

Do I need experience in trekking for this trip?

+

No, this trip is suitable for moderate trekkers. While the trek to Fairy Meadows and Nanga Parbat Base Camp can be challenging, the pace is manageable for those with basic fitness levels. However, prior hiking experience is beneficial.

02

Is the trek suitable for families?

+

Yes, the trek can be enjoyed by families, though children should be in good physical condition and comfortable with hiking. The shorter treks around Fairy Meadows and Nanga Parbat Base Camp are generally accessible for younger trekkers, but we recommend checking the difficulty level before bringing young children.

03

What are the accommodation options during the trek?

+
  • Fairy Meadows: Stay options include Fairy Meadows Cottages, Raikot Sarai, or luxury tents depending on your preferences.
  • Chilas: There are options like Shangrila Hotel Chilas for premium stays and Indus Lodges for more budget-friendly choices.
  • Other Nights: Comfortable hotels like Hilton Hotel Besham or Sarai Hotel Naran for overnight stays on the return leg of the journey.
04

How difficult is the trek to Fairy Meadows and Nanga Parbat Base Camp?

+

The trek to Fairy Meadows is moderate, with a 2-3 hour walk from Tattu Village. For those opting for the Nanga Parbat Base Camp trek, it is a challenging 6-7 hour round trip with an elevation gain. You need good fitness and stamina for this section.

05

What is the weather like during the trek?

+

The weather can vary greatly depending on the season:

  • Spring/Autumn: Mild during the day, but cool at night.
  • Summer: Pleasant with warm days and cooler nights in the mountains.
  • Winter: Cold, with snow and icy conditions, especially at higher altitudes.
06

Is there any mobile network coverage in Fairy Meadows?

+

Mobile network coverage is limited in remote areas like Fairy Meadows. It’s advisable to inform family or friends in advance about your travel plans and expected availability.

07

What do I need to carry for the trek?

+

You should bring:

  • Comfortable trekking gear (shoes, backpack, clothing)
  • Personal essentials (ID, camera, water bottle, snacks)
  • Weather-appropriate clothing (depending on the season)
  • Sleeping bag and trekking poles (optional for camping and stability)
08

Will food and water be provided during the trek?

+

Yes, meals will be provided during the trek, including traditional Pakistani food at the camps and hotels. However, you should carry additional snacks like energy bars or trail mix for the journey.

09

Is there any health risk on this trek?

+

There is a low risk of altitude sickness since the trek does not involve very high altitudes. However, it’s always a good idea to be cautious and hydrate well. Carry any personal medication you may need, especially for allergies or other conditions.

10

How long is the total trek?

+

The entire trek to Fairy Meadows and Nanga Parbat Base Camp spans over 5-7 days, including travel time from Islamabad to the destination and back. You will spend multiple nights at Fairy Meadows, with time for exploration, relaxing, and optional additional trekking.

11

Can I customize my itinerary or add extra days?

+

Yes! This trip can be customized based on your preferences. You can add extra days for rest, exploration, or visit other scenic spots nearby. Please discuss with the tour operator for personalized adjustments.

12

Are there any optional activities during the trek?

+

Yes! You can opt for the Nanga Parbat Base Camp trek, exploring local villages, or simply relaxing and enjoying the scenic beauty of Fairy Meadows.

FAQs

Have Questions?

We've Got Answers!

Answers To Most Of Your Questions

Ask a question

About Summit Experts & Our Guides:

01

Who leads your expeditions and tours?

+

Summit Experts was founded by the late Shah Doulat, one of Pakistan's most respected high-altitude mountaineers. Today the company is led by his family and a team of guides rooted in Shimshal — the "Valley of Mountaineers" — many of whom climbed and trained alongside Shah himself. You travel with locals who know these mountains better than anyone.

02

How experienced are your guides?

+

Our guides include climbers who have summited K2, Nanga Parbat, Gasherbrum II, Spantik, and many other peaks, as well as cultural guides with deep knowledge of Gilgit-Baltistan and Chitral. We work with both men and women guides for expeditions and cultural tours. Through the Shah Doulat Alpine Guide Fellowship, we also train and support the next generation of Pakistani mountain guides.

03

What makes Summit Experts different from other operators?

+

We are a locally owned company born in the Karakoram, not an outside agency. That means deeper local knowledge, stronger logistics, fair support for our mountain communities, and a genuine connection to the land. We also offer flexible service — from fully guided expeditions to logistics-only support for independent alpinists.

Booking & Payment:

01

How do I book a trip?

+

Booking can be completed via our website. A deposit secures your spot, and the remaining balance is paid upon arrival.

02

What payment methods do you accept?

+

We accept credit cards, bank transfers, and cash. Specific payment details are available during the booking process.

03

What is the cancellation and refund policy?

+

Cancellations made 60+ days before departure qualify for a partial refund. Deposits are non-refundable after permits and flights are booked.

04

Are fixed departures guaranteed?

+

Fixed departures require a minimum of four participants but are generally guaranteed for July and August.

Visas & Travel:

01

Do I need a visa to travel to Pakistan?

+

Yes, most nationalities require a tourist visa. We provide invitation letters and supporting documents for visa applications.

02

What documents are required for my trip?

+

A valid passport, visa, travel insurance, and permits are necessary. Ensure your passport has at least six months of validity.

03

How do I apply for a Pakistani visa?

+

Apply through the Pakistan Online Visa System. We assist with supporting documents like invitation letters and itineraries.

04

Will I be picked up at the airport?

+

Yes, our team will greet you at Islamabad International Airport with a visible company placard.

Packing & Preparation:

01

What should I pack for high-altitude treks?

+

Essentials include trekking boots, layered clothing, sleeping bags, and a first-aid kit. A detailed list will be provided upon booking.

02

Do you provide gear or equipment rentals?

+

Yes, equipment like crampons and harnesses can be rented in Skardu. Availability varies, so confirm in advance.

03

How should I prepare for the trek?

+

Engage in regular cardio and strength training. Prepare for varied terrains, including glaciers and steep climbs.

04

What’s the baggage allowance for domestic flights?

+

Domestic flights allow 20kg of checked luggage and 7kg of hand luggage. Additional weight incurs extra charges.

Safety:

01

What precautions are taken to ensure safety during treks?

+

Guides are trained in first aid and equipped with emergency kits. Satellite communication is available for remote locations.

02

What happens in case of altitude sickness?

+

Guides are trained to recognize symptoms and will assist with descent or evacuation if necessary.

03

Is Pakistan safe for foreign travelers?

+

Yes, regions like Gilgit-Baltistan are extremely safe and tourist-friendly. We monitor local conditions closely.

04

How do you ensure safety during political or weather challenges?

+

We adjust itineraries to avoid risk areas and prioritize guest safety. All treks are planned with contingency options.

A Journey to Remember
I just returned from an incredible month-long adventure in northern Pakistan with Summit Experts Adventure Tours. We trekked through some of the most breathtaking regions: Skardu, Hunza, Shimshal Village, and made our way to Shimshal Pass, ending with the exhilarating summit of Manglik Sar (6050m). From the very first moment, I knew I was in the hands of true professionals. The entire trip was perfectly organized, from the logistics to safety measures. But what truly made this experience stand out was the team. Every single person was warm, supportive, and treated me like family. Over the course of the trek, they all became a second family to me, and I genuinely feel like I’ve made lifelong friends. The beauty of the Karakoram combined with the knowledge, passion, and dedication of the Summit Experts team made this adventure unforgettable. I felt supported, safe, and inspired every single day. I don’t add pictures, because you MUST visit and see all the beauty of Pakistan with your own eyes. Nothing can compare to standing there in person, taking in the vastness and the majesty of the Karakoram range. Thanks to the expertise of Summit Experts, I felt safe and supported every step of the way. The team’s passion for the mountains and commitment to making sure each trekker has the best possible experience is what really sets them apart. This wasn’t just a trek—it was an unforgettable journey, and I already can’t wait to return. I’m already thinking about next year and planning to do even more trekking in Pakistan. There’s so much more to explore, and I wouldn’t want to do it with anyone else but Summit Experts. If you’re considering an adventure in Pakistan, I cannot recommend this company enough. Thank you, Summit Experts, for an experience I’ll never forget.

Beyond the ordinary
It took me some time to find the right words to capture the incredible memories we created during our trip to northern Pakistan this April—blossom season at its absolute best! The breathtaking views, the warmth of the people, and the richness of the culture left a lasting impression on me, all made even more special by the Summit Experts Adventure Tours team. Their approach was not just professional but also incredibly humble and flexible, ensuring we had an unforgettable experience. Our group of five Thai friends explored Skardu, Hunza, Passu, and Gilgit at the peak of blossom season. Guided by the company’s CEO, Shah, whose extensive expertise in hiking and expeditions was evident, we found ourselves on a well-planned yet refreshingly adaptable journey. We appreciated how our tour leader went above and beyond, recommending exclusive experiences—from an insightful cultural visit to a local Pakistani home to a glacier trek using a unique route. Unlike standard itineraries, this allowed us to truly get up close and touch the glacier, all while ensuring our safety with expert guidance. One of the highlights was our trek to Fairy Meadows. With hours of hiking ahead, our guide was highly attentive, carefully assessing the natural conditions and our group’s well-being, which made us feel completely safe every step of the way. I already can't wait to return to Pakistan in summer, autumn, and beyond! 😊 A little tip for fellow travelers: If you plan to visit areas that require trekking and hiking, I highly recommend familiarizing yourself with the terrain beforehand. You can always check with the Summit Experts Adventure Tours team about the travel conditions—just to be prepared, not to opt out! The beauty of northern Pakistan is absolutely worth the effort.

Overview

Embark on a spectacular 9-day aerial adventure to Hunza Valley, a gem of Gilgit-Baltistan. This all-season tour combines breathtaking mountain scenery, rich culture, and historic landmarks, offering an ideal getaway for travelers seeking both adventure and tranquility. Fly directly into the heart of the Karakoram, exploring vibrant bazaars, ancient forts, and the stunning landscapes of Gojal and Nagar Valleys.

Why This Tour?

  • Scenic Aerial Views – Enjoy breathtaking views of Nanga Parbat and the Karakoram range from the air.
  • Cultural Immersion – Explore historic Baltit and Altit forts and experience Hunza’s warm hospitality.
  • Majestic Landscapes – Visit Attabad Lake, Khunjerab National Park, and Naltar Valley, renowned for their natural beauty.
  • Comfort and Convenience – Experience hassle-free travel with flights, premium accommodations, and expert guides.

Itinerary

Day 1: Arrival in Islamabad – Welcome to Pakistan

Arrive at Islamabad International Airport, where our team will greet you and escort you to your hotel. Rest and relax before meeting the group for dinner and exploring the local area at your leisure.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Islamabad Serena Hotel
  • Luxury: Roomy Signature Hotel
  • Standard: Grand Islamabad Hotel

Day 2: Hunza Valley – Heritage and Scenic Beauty

Fly from Islamabad to Gilgit and then enjoy a scenic drive to Hunza Valley, pausing at the Rakaposhi View Point. Explore Baltit Fort, wander Karimabad Bazaar, visit historic Altit Fort, and ascend to Duikar for panoramic views. Relax at your hotel and explore the charming surroundings.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Hunza Serena Hotel
  • Luxury: Eagles Nest Hotel
  • Standard: Ayash Resort

Day 3: Gojal Valley – Attabad Lake & Gulmit Village

Depart for Gojal Valley, driving through the majestic Attabad Tunnels and making a stop at the stunning Attabad Lake. After checking into your hotel, explore the quaint Gulmit Village and hike the scenic Ondra Poyga trail to Kamaris Village.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Luxus Resort Hunza
  • Luxury: Famree Resort
  • Standard: Silk Route Lodge

Day 4: Khunjerab National Park – Gateway to China

Embark on an exciting journey to Khunjerab National Park. Cross the famous Hussaini Suspension Bridge, pass through the picturesque Passu Village, and marvel at the Passu Cones. At Khunjerab Pass, enjoy wildlife spotting and breathtaking views before returning to your hotel.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Luxus Resort Hunza
  • Luxury: Famree Resort
  • Standard: Silk Route Lodge

Day 5: Nagar Valley – Hoper Glacier Exploration

Depart for Nagar Valley, making brief stops along the way. Enjoy stunning views of Nagar and visit the spectacular Hoper Glacier viewpoint. Take a short hike for closer views of the glacier and explore at your leisure before returning to Hunza.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Hunza Serena Inn
  • Luxury: Eagles Nest Hotel
  • Standard: Ayash Resort

Day 6: Naltar Valley – Hidden Paradise

Travel to Naltar Valley via Nomal, exploring its famed Wildlife Sanctuary. Enjoy the natural beauty, visit the vibrant Satrangi Lake, and then head to Gilgit City for a visit to Kargah Buddha and NLI Market.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Gilgit Serena Hotel
  • Luxury: Riverdale Hotel
  • Standard: Mandarian Inn

Day 7: Return to Islamabad – Leisure Time

Fly back to Islamabad, transfer to your hotel, and enjoy leisure time exploring the city or relaxing. In the evening, savor dinner with our team.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Islamabad Serena Hotel
  • Luxury: Roomy Signature Hotel
  • Standard: Grand Islamabad Hotel

Day 8: Islamabad City Tour – Cultural Exploration

Explore Islamabad’s landmarks, including the Faisal Mosque, Pakistan Monument, and Daman-e-Koh viewpoint. Spend free time shopping or relaxing, soaking in the capital’s vibrant atmosphere.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Islamabad Serena Hotel
  • Luxury: Roomy Signature Hotel
  • Standard: Grand Islamabad Hotel

Day 9: Departure – Farewell Pakistan

Transfer to Islamabad Airport for your flight home, carrying unforgettable memories of Hunza Valley’s breathtaking beauty.

Itinerary

Day 1: Arrival in Islamabad – Welcome to Pakistan

Arrive at Islamabad International Airport, where our team will greet you and escort you to your hotel. Rest and relax before meeting the group for dinner and exploring the local area at your leisure.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Islamabad Serena Hotel
  • Luxury: Roomy Signature Hotel
  • Standard: Grand Islamabad Hotel

Day 2: Hunza Valley – Heritage and Scenic Beauty

Fly from Islamabad to Gilgit and then enjoy a scenic drive to Hunza Valley, pausing at the Rakaposhi View Point. Explore Baltit Fort, wander Karimabad Bazaar, visit historic Altit Fort, and ascend to Duikar for panoramic views. Relax at your hotel and explore the charming surroundings.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Hunza Serena Hotel
  • Luxury: Eagles Nest Hotel
  • Standard: Ayash Resort

Day 3: Gojal Valley – Attabad Lake & Gulmit Village

Depart for Gojal Valley, driving through the majestic Attabad Tunnels and making a stop at the stunning Attabad Lake. After checking into your hotel, explore the quaint Gulmit Village and hike the scenic Ondra Poyga trail to Kamaris Village.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Luxus Resort Hunza
  • Luxury: Famree Resort
  • Standard: Silk Route Lodge

Day 4: Khunjerab National Park – Gateway to China

Embark on an exciting journey to Khunjerab National Park. Cross the famous Hussaini Suspension Bridge, pass through the picturesque Passu Village, and marvel at the Passu Cones. At Khunjerab Pass, enjoy wildlife spotting and breathtaking views before returning to your hotel.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Luxus Resort Hunza
  • Luxury: Famree Resort
  • Standard: Silk Route Lodge

Day 5: Nagar Valley – Hoper Glacier Exploration

Depart for Nagar Valley, making brief stops along the way. Enjoy stunning views of Nagar and visit the spectacular Hoper Glacier viewpoint. Take a short hike for closer views of the glacier and explore at your leisure before returning to Hunza.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Hunza Serena Inn
  • Luxury: Eagles Nest Hotel
  • Standard: Ayash Resort

Day 6: Naltar Valley – Hidden Paradise

Travel to Naltar Valley via Nomal, exploring its famed Wildlife Sanctuary. Enjoy the natural beauty, visit the vibrant Satrangi Lake, and then head to Gilgit City for a visit to Kargah Buddha and NLI Market.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Gilgit Serena Hotel
  • Luxury: Riverdale Hotel
  • Standard: Mandarian Inn

Day 7: Return to Islamabad – Leisure Time

Fly back to Islamabad, transfer to your hotel, and enjoy leisure time exploring the city or relaxing. In the evening, savor dinner with our team.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Islamabad Serena Hotel
  • Luxury: Roomy Signature Hotel
  • Standard: Grand Islamabad Hotel

Day 8: Islamabad City Tour – Cultural Exploration

Explore Islamabad’s landmarks, including the Faisal Mosque, Pakistan Monument, and Daman-e-Koh viewpoint. Spend free time shopping or relaxing, soaking in the capital’s vibrant atmosphere.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Islamabad Serena Hotel
  • Luxury: Roomy Signature Hotel
  • Standard: Grand Islamabad Hotel

Day 9: Departure – Farewell Pakistan

Transfer to Islamabad Airport for your flight home, carrying unforgettable memories of Hunza Valley’s breathtaking beauty.

Packing List

Packing Checklist for Northern Pakistan - Summit Experts

Traveling to the scenic mountains of Northern Pakistan during summer and autumn (June to mid-November) requires smart packing. The weather is cool and crisp, and the landscapes are stunning, making it an ideal time for a memorable journey. To ensure you have everything you need, here’s our recommended packing list.

Essential Packing Categories:

  1. Luggage & Bags
    • Main Bag (70-80L): A sturdy, spacious bag for all your essentials. Consider a duffel or rucksack with waterproof covers.
    • Carry-On/Daypack (30-40L): Ideal for carrying daily items and essentials during flights and local travel.
    • Padlocks: For added security during travel.
  2. Clothing
    • Upper Body:
      • Insulated Jacket: Lightweight but warm, perfect for layering.
      • Fleece or Soft Shell Jacket: To keep warm without feeling too bulky.
      • Long-Sleeve Shirts & T-Shirts: Preferably quick-drying fabrics.
    • Lower Body:
      • Trekking Trousers: Comfortable, quick-drying trousers suitable for hikes.
      • Thermal Underwear: For colder days and nights.
    • General Tips:
      • Layers are Key: Autumn weather can be unpredictable; layering helps you adjust to changes in temperature.
      • Modest Clothing: Covering shoulders and knees is recommended in urban areas and when visiting cultural sites.
  3. Footwear
    • Hiking Boots: Well-worn, waterproof boots with good ankle support.
    • Warm Socks: Opt for wool or moisture-wicking material.
    • Extra Laces: Just in case.
  4. Accessories
    • Sunglasses & Sunblock (SPF 50+): The sun can be strong, even in cooler weather.
    • Hat/Cap: For sun protection.
    • Warm Beanie: Essential for cooler mornings and evenings.
  5. Toiletries & Personal Care
    • Travel Towel & Wet Wipes: Compact and quick-drying options.
    • Basic Hygiene Kit: Include toothpaste, deodorant, lip balm, and moisturizers.
    • Hand Sanitizer & Masks: Always useful.
  6. Hydration & Snacks
    • Water Bottle (Insulated Recommended): Carry at least a 1L bottle for day trips.
    • Energy Snacks: Granola bars, dried fruits, and nuts for quick energy during hikes.
  7. Tech & Gadgets
    • Camera & Spare Batteries: Capture the beauty of autumn landscapes. Bring extra memory cards.
    • Power Bank: To keep devices charged during long excursions.
  8. Important Documents
    • Passport: With at least six months of validity and two blank pages.
    • Visa & Travel Insurance: Check requirements and ensure you have printouts of all travel documents.
    • Emergency Contacts: Keep a printed list of important contact numbers.

Tips for Autumn and Summer Packing

  • Plan for Cool Nights: While days can be mild, temperatures drop quickly in the evenings. A warm jacket and thermal wear will be your best friends.
  • Pack Light but Smart: Choose versatile clothing that can be mixed and matched.
  • Respect Local Culture: While locals are friendly, it’s respectful to dress modestly, especially in towns and when visiting religious sites.

Why Travel with Summit Experts?

Our tours are designed with your comfort and safety in mind. We make sure you’re prepared for every aspect of your trip so that you can focus on enjoying the beauty of Northern Pakistan.
